allowing candidates to raise objections/claims. After resolving objections
the final list will be published on the website and notice board.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for SMKV Bastar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.smkvbastar.ac.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Shaheed Mahendra Karma Vishwavidyalaya Bastar (SMKV Bastar) for filling up various academic positions on a contract basis in Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under SMKV Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 16 vacancies have been announced for Guest Lecturer and Guest Teaching Assistant posts across various departments and subjects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 07-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for SMKV Bastar Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it via registered or speed post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduation degree in the relevant subject with a minimum of 55% marks, along with qualifications such as NET, SET, or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years. There are no minimum age restrictions mentioned beyond standard eligibility requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Guest Lecturers?
faq.answer: Guest Lecturers will receive Rs. 2000 per day, subject to a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000 per month as per university guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Guest Teaching Assistants?
faq.answer: Guest Teaching Assistants are entitled to a daily remuneration of Rs. 1400 per day, with a maximum cap of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by registered or speed post to the Registrar, Shaheed Mahendra Karma Vishwavidyalaya, Bastar, Dharampura-2, Jagdalpur, Dist.-Bastar, Chhattisgarh, Pin-494001.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be done through a merit list prepared on the basis of academic qualifications and subsequent interview or document verification.
